# xna10-clean

Original synthetic code written for this repository. It contains no third-party code or assets and is released under the repository license.

## Purpose

The negative case for the XNA 1.0 and 2.0 rules: an Express 1.0 project (framework version `v1.0`, Express targets) whose code only clears the screen. It is never built.

## What the analyzer should find

- XNA version 1.0.
- Project findings only: XNA001, XNA002, XNA003 and XNA100.
- None of XNA101 to XNA105 and none of the XNA 3.x API rules.
